release.content: integrations 0.14.1 was released on 2026-11-06 from commit 548e61b426ad17b59b20d8621b521489a1931b7d with these changes.

rows: The service and the ingest pod answer /livez while the process is up; /healthz is integrations.calls.health over their checks: the ingest pod is unready, with 503, once its scanner goes three intervals without finishing a pass, and the service lists a storage buffer it can't reach as an alert only, since a call needs nothing it holds
The ingest pod loads observability's signals, when INGEST_SIGNALS names their tenant and dataset, from that tenant's inbox/signals/ into the dataset's signals table
The cloudflare.workers plugin, for Workers deploys
workers/call-log, a Durable Object per Cloudflare sender that keeps its call records durably and writes its file every two minutes, even an idle one, with caller.js's CallLogSink to send it records
